label.explanation: msg-798041 at partition 10 offset 269792 contains bytes order-consumer cannot parse. It is nacked and redelivered forever because no max-retries/DLQ is configured (lines 159, 160, 166, 167, 175, 176, 189, 190). That message blocks its partition, so lag grows (lines 174, 207, 227, 238, 266, 274, 297) and downstream work stalls (lines 188, 241, 257, 286). The consumer has capacity — it's stuck on one message. Dead-letter msg-798041 and add a retry limit. Red herrings: lines 70, 71 (a single card processor connection reset that succeeded on retry, minutes before onset); line 61 (a single long GC pause in a healthy service, with heap well below limits).
